arrangement.notes: Arrangement focuses on gradual energy increase with vocal-centric dynamics and emotional delivery while maintaining traditional Arabesk instrumental textures.

event_markers.label: Hook Start
event_markers.reason: Energy rises and vocal focus peaks

event_markers.label: Final Hook
event_markers.reason: Climactic vocal section and maximum energy

event_markers.label: Outro
event_markers.reason: Energy winds down, closing the track

track_roles.drums: provide rhythmic foundation supporting emotional build
track_roles.bass: support groove with steady and expressive lines
track_roles.chords: create harmonic backdrop with traditional Arabesk textures
track_roles.melody: add subtle instrumental contours under vocals
track_roles.vocal: lead emotional expression with focus on delivery and dynamics
track_roles.fx: enhance atmosphere with ambient and transitional elements

sensei_drum.brief: Generate drum patterns that start minimal and grow in complexity following the slow build energy curve, emphasizing emotional support for vocals.

bass_generator.brief: Create expressive and supportive bass lines that complement the Arabesk harmonic style and dynamics of the energy build.

harmony_generator.brief: Develop chord voicings and progressions using Arabesk style instrumentation to support emotional mood and gradual energy increase.

melody_generator.brief: Produce subtle instrumental melodic elements that enhance and interact softly with the vocal lines, maintaining emotional tone.

ai_designer.brief: Oversee arrangement dynamics ensuring the gradual energy build is smooth and vocal focus remains prominent throughout the sections.

presetor.brief: Apply presets that emphasize warm, emotional tones suitable for Arabesk Rap with clear vocal presence and natural instrument textures.

songgps.brief: Guide section transitions and energy flow to align with slow build profile and emotional progression in the arrangement.

ai_mixmaster.brief: Prepare mix settings that keep vocals clear and present while balancing traditional Arabesk instruments and gradual dynamic changes.
